title: SCPN Beam Target Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the beam-target and colliding-beam fusion configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (the published cross-section fit of the light-ion reactions at the energy a declared configuration presents to a target at rest, and what a declared beam current and energy amount to), and tessellated and B-rep models of a beam line and what it fires into. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
